Just wanted to make sure the devs saw this:

http://arxiv.org/abs/1410.4984
Gaussian Process Models with Parallelization and GPU acceleration

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] GPU for speeding up GPs
parts:
This'd be a great project for someone. The main issues
are getting autodiff to work (ideally by isolating some computations
the way we can do for matrices), introducing the right sparse
data structures into Stan, and then sorting out the build
issues cross platform. Another issue is whether to build something
custom for a single style of GP model or work on GPU integration
for our more usual matrix library (which might not help much with
GPs in particular).

All potentially do-able, but not on any of the Stan developers' horizon.

- Bob
